Name: Quality Fishing
Author: pomarf
Description:
[b][size=4][u]About this mod:[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It's a really simple mod actually.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Essentially, this mod replicates the functionality from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/866]Teh's Fishing Overhaul[/url] that increases the quality of the fish you catch as your perfect fishing streak increases.[/color][/size]
[size=3]You can adjust how how many caught fish it takes to hit the next quality level. Anywhere from 1 fish to 10 fish.[/size]

[b][size=4][u]Multiplayer:[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3]As far as I can tell it should work in multiplayer.[/size]
[color=#ff7700][size=3]Only issue is non host streak count will get reset on re-joining the game.[/size][/color]

[b][size=4][u]Compatibility:[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3]It should work with any fish from any mod.[/size]

[b][color=#980000][size=4]Disclaimer:[/size][/color]
[/b][size=3][i][color=#ffffff]I highly doubt I will ever update this mod, realistically I just made this mod for John. [/color][color=#999999]I can see you reading this John.[/color][/i][/size]
[size=3][color=#980000][u][b]So because of that I have included the raw ModEntry.cs as an optional download for use in the following emergencies:[/b][/u][/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#980000]If this mod stops working in the future and you want to update it, just maybe throw me some credit.[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][color=#980000]Or if you wanna use this mod as part your own mod, again, credit would be pretty cool.[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#980000][size=3][b]Or if you are just curious and wanna see how it works, that is also a completely valid option.[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Quality Fishing
Manifest.Description: Increase fish quality based on your current perfect catch streak.
